label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 120D

obligations.text:
Duty to consult other regulators
(1)
The Commission must, at such times as the Commission considers appropriate, consult the persons mentioned in subsection (2) about how the manner in which the Commission exercises functions under the data protection legislation may affect economic growth, innovation and competition.
